title: EA says it used AI and archival recordings to add late soccer commentator John Motson to EA Sports FC 27, with permission from Motson's widow and son (Tom Gerken/BBC)
summary: Tom Gerken / BBC: EA says it used AI and archival recordings to add late soccer commentator John Motson to EA Sports FC 27, with permission from Motson's widow and son — Football game EA Sports FC will feature the digitally recreated voice of the late commentator John Motson, Electronic Arts has exclusively told the BBC.
